messages:
maya: Quick PSA — after the Friday deploy I noticed a couple of dead links under the runtime guide in staging. Can someone take a quick look? :thinking_face:

sam: Thanks for catching — which pages/anchors?

maya: /runtime/kv-cache.md returns 404 and the batching page anchor /runtime/batching/#best-practices jumps to the wrong section.

lee: I can grab the kv-cache one. Probably a path rename during the last refactor. @nora can you double-check the batching anchor? I can open a tiny PR.

nora: Yep, taking a look now. The anchor text changed to "best-practice" in the markdown. Will update to match and push a redirect.

docs-bot: link-scan CI found 2 broken links in docs: /runtime/kv-cache.md, /runtime/batching/#best-practices. Scan run: 2026-03-20T18:12:00Z

sam: If you open a small PR, tag me for review. Also can we add an automated small-run in staging on deploy to catch these? :+1:

lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4124 — fixes kv-cache path and adds a test to alert the build. @maya can you confirm staging path works when you have a sec?

maya: Checked staging — both links resolve now. Thanks! I'll mark the issue as closed and add the owner line to the kv-cache file (owner: lee) for future pings.

sam: Nice. Optional follow-up: add a short checklist in the runtime doc's frontmatter for owners (links, sample curl, minimal smoke-test). Not urgent but will reduce churn.

nora: Agree. I'll draft a tiny frontmatter template and put it in the repo under /docs/.github/doc-templates.md

maya: Great — thanks team :rocket:
